name: Hazoret
description: Hazoret is the jackal-headed, spear-wielding god of zeal of Amonkhet, who survived the other gods and became the last pillar of Amonkhet.

description_citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

summary.text: Hazoret is the jackal-headed, spear-wielding god of zeal of Amonkhet, who survived the other gods and became the last pillar of Amonkhet.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

bio.text: Hazoret presided over the final Trial, ordered Samut seized as a dissenter, and cast her mark of battle rage over everyone as the Trial began.

citations.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.
"Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

bio.text: When the dragon came she and Oketra fled to a mausoleum to gather orphaned children, and when the Gate opened onto endless wastes instead of paradise, Hazoret did not answer Samut's question.

citations.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.
"The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

bio.text: As the gods died one by one she was left with only Bontu, and she named Djeru her final champion.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

bio.text: Nicol Bolas emerged from a rift above the God-Pharaoh's throne, and Bontu, revealed as his servant, attacked Hazoret at his command and unlocked her suppressed memories of his deception.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

bio.text: Bontu freed Hazoret and died, leaving Hazoret alone as the last pillar of Amonkhet.

citations.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.
"Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

bio.text: She burned the scorpion god, her brother in dark form, with her spear after losing an arm to his poison, and then led the survivors into the desert.

citations.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

status.text: Hazoret is alive as of the latest story in September 2026, where she leads Samut and Djeru to face the illusion, and Samut is her champion.

citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
"Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leads her friends to an old mural of Hazoret and strange fighting forms, which she performs.
timeline.quote: Samut assumed the first stance on the mural

citation.text: "Trespass" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru leaves, saying he will plead to Hazoret for her, which gives Samut an idea.
timeline.quote: I'll plead to Hazoret for you.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut enters Hazoret's monument and requests an audience with the god.
timeline.quote: I request an audience, mighty Hazoret.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret not to take Djeru's life, and Hazoret questions her right to cage his heart.
timeline.quote: I have come to plead for Djeru's survival.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut dares to ask whether Hazoret herself is mistaken and appeals to the god of compassion she once was before the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: Any tiny sliver of a memory of that time before the God-Pharaoh?

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret curses Samut and orders the anointed to seize the dissenter.
timeline.quote: Seize the dissenter.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: All the gods approach and Hazoret takes Samut and the Gatewatch to face the last initiates, knocking them out.
timeline.quote: Your time has come

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret orders the initiates to kill the heretics and starts the final Trial, casting her mark of battle rage over everyone.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's mark of battle rage appeared over their heads.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru prays for Samut's forgiveness while he and Samut fight, and he slices Gideon's arm.
timeline.quote: cutting a sleek, shallow slice cut through Gideon's forearm

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The battle magic fades, and Djeru surrenders his khopesh and prays for Samut's glorified death.
timeline.quote: Djeru concluded with his khopesh on the ground, a formal surrender.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret asks Djeru to claim his place, and he accepts, but Samut declines Hazoret's gift.
timeline.quote: Without hesitation, she shook her head.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: As Hazoret strikes, Samut tackles Djeru out of the way and Gideon blocks the spear with his golden barrier.
timeline.quote: He stood between them and Hazoret's spear

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun passes through the horns, a shadow crosses the arena, and the Hours begin.
timeline.quote: It has begun. The Hours have begun!

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Gideon, left behind, recalls Hazoret whispering to him that she sees his death and that he is no god.
timeline.quote: for I see your death, Kytheon Iora.

citation.text: "Judgment" by Alison Lührs, Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 May 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret and Oketra flee to a mausoleum and gather the orphaned children as the dragon follows.
timeline.quote: Hazoret began gently picking up as many children as she could.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The dragon breaks the seal and blanks the minds of Hazoret and Oketra, who fall defeated.
timeline.quote: the minds of the two gods went utterly blank.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Djeru and Samut run to the Luxa as the Hours begin amid a stampede of citizens, and Hazoret strides to the river.
timeline.quote: all racing toward the banks of the Luxa River.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The second sun reaches its final point and the Gate cracks open, then swings wide to reveal endless wastes instead of paradise.
timeline.quote: What lay beyond the Gate were endless, empty wastes.

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks Hazoret if that is paradise, and the god does not answer.
timeline.quote: Is that paradise?

citation.text: "The Hour of Revelation" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: All five gods gather at the bloody Luxa, but the God-Pharaoh does not arrive.
timeline.quote: The five stood before the crimson shores of the Luxa

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: The Luxa drains through the opened Gate as the demon's spell unravels old magics.
timeline.quote: all that remained of the mighty Luxa was a few rivulets of red

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Oketra rallies the stunned gods, and Hazoret is disturbed that Rhonas blasphemed the God-Pharaoh.
timeline.quote: doubt nibbled at the edges of her heart

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hapatra resolves to find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.
timeline.quote: We must find Bontu and Hazoret and keep them alive at all costs.

citation.text: "The Hour of Promise" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Jun 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret feels a third god die and kneels in despair, knowing only she and Bontu remain.
timeline.quote: Bontu and I are all that remain.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret lets go into her battle frenzy, cutting through mummies, saving a child and burning a hellion.
timeline.quote: Hazoret let go of any shreds of doubt and uncertainty

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret meets Samut and Djeru and orders them to protect others and hide until the God-Pharaoh comes, calling Djeru her final champion.
timeline.quote: And you, Djeru, my final champion.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut asks who will protect Hazoret, who tells her to fight and says she will endure.
timeline.quote: Who will protect you , Hazoret?

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret burns locusts from the God-Pharaoh's throne and prays for his return.
timeline.quote: She prayed to the God-Pharaoh for his return.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A rift in the sky above the throne tears open and Nicol Bolas, the golden God-Pharaoh, emerges.
timeline.quote: The God-Pharaoh had arrived.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret shields the mortals with sand and flame and realizes the God-Pharaoh brings only destruction.
timeline.quote: He rains destruction upon his people, his children.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu kneels, hails Nicol Bolas by name and declares her servitude, revealing she has served him and culled dissenters.
timeline.quote: I have culled dissenters from all the crops

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bolas commands Bontu to kill her sister, and Bontu blasts Hazoret with dark energy.
timeline.quote: Kill your sister.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu's spell unlocks Hazoret's suppressed memories, and she remembers Bolas's deception.
timeline.quote: And suddenly, Hazoret remembered everything.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu explains she chose survival by joining Bolas, and the sisters duel.
timeline.quote: I chose to join with his power instead. I chose survival.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bites Hazoret's arm, Hazoret burns her way free, and Bontu summons horrors that bind Hazoret in tar.
timeline.quote: their shadowy forms coalescing into a binding morass, restraining her.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu drains Hazoret and drops her at Bolas's feet, then Bolas blasts Bontu, calling her usefulness ended.
timeline.quote: Slowly, he raised one claw—and blasted Bontu with a bolt of dark energy.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Bontu bursts free, slays the undead, frees Hazoret, and dies, severing her ties to the world.
timeline.quote: Bontu fell, the dragon's necrotic spell severing the final leylines that tied the god to this world.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret alone remains as the last pillar of Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: And Hazoret alone remained, the last pillar of Amonkhet.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leads a band of survivors toward the desert at Hazoret's command, guarded by Djeru.
timeline.quote: Hazoret's command burned at the back of Samut's thoughts as they moved.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: A sandstorm sweeps in as an injured Hazoret emerges pursued by the scorpion god.
timeline.quote: A scorpion's tail pierced through the haze

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret traps the scorpion god in a pillar of flame, but it keeps coming and poisons her arm, which she cauterizes and severs.
timeline.quote: Hazoret crouched, panting hard, blood seeping from the wound that had saved her life.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut leaps onto the scorpion god and cuts through its softened carapace while the survivors fight it.
timeline.quote: She smashed into the scorpion god's side, and her blades pierced its carapace

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret finishes the scorpion god with her spear, freeing him as her brother from his dark form.
timeline.quote: the god reduced to cinders and ash.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret thanks Samut, and Samut's planeswalker spark ignites; she is carried to another plane and returns to Amonkhet.
timeline.quote: she was falling, falling through space, through flashing waves of aether

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Samut realizes she is a walker between worlds and returns to Amonkhet, then collapses and is caught by Hazoret.
timeline.quote: I am a walker between worlds.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Hazoret tells the survivors to endure and leads them into the desert as Bolas flies above, and Djeru and the survivors kneel to her.
timeline.quote: we must simply endure, persist, survive

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

timeline.summary: Across the Multiverse the worlds begin to overlay; on Ravnica, Bloomburrow, Amonkhet and Dominaria, people see doubles of their worlds.
timeline.quote: Meanwhile, the worlds begin to overlay.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 9: Unafraid" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Sep 2026.

relations.note: siblings among the gods; he worked closest with her
relations.quote: Rhonas had worked the closest with Hazoret

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

relations.quote: The depth of Bontu's betrayal sent Hazoret's mind churning between fury and despair.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

relations.quote: Have you forgotten who I am, sister?

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

relations.note: commands her death and corrupted her memories
relations.quote: The full weight of Bolas's deception and Bontu's betrayal crashed over her

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

relations.quote: As a vizier of Hazoret, though, his heart beat as one with his god

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

relations.quote: she is still seen as Hazoret's champion

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

citation.text: "Hour of Glory" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2017.

citation.text: "Favor" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Jul 2017.

pages_say.description: The last surviving god of Amonkhet, who burns the scorpion god, loses an arm and leads her people into the desert.

citation.text: "Endure" by Michael Yichao. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Jul 2017.

pages_say.description: An Amonkhet God whose spear is used against Bolas.

pages_say.description: A god of Amonkhet whose trials killed many and whom the twins revere.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Hour of Restoration" by Hadeer Elsbai. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.
